desc: Vision Type-N safety eyewear is built on a lightweight, wraparound frameless impact-resistant polycarbonate structure for maximum field of vision and comprehensive eye protection. Designed for indoor or outdoor use across various industries the Vision Type-N safety eyewear has both an anti-fog and an anti-scratch lens coating. Its beveled lens edge offers additional eye protection and its soft-molded TPR ear padding and nose bridge offer a more secure, comfortable, and non-slip fit. The clear lens color provides all-day clarity and protection.
